title: Kates Disruption Plan & Playbook v1
description: Multi-step Kubernetes & Kafka disruption plan or playbook with blast-radius safety guards, ISR/lag recovery tracking, and SLA grading.

name.description: Unique name of the disruption plan or playbook (e.g., az-failure, leader-cascade).

description.description: Human-readable summary of the failure mode and hypothesis.

steps.description: Sequential fault injection steps executed by the DisruptionOrchestrator.

sla.description: SLA thresholds graded across the disruption run.

testType.description: Background workload test type executed during the disruption plan.

baselineDurationSec.description: Initial baseline traffic duration in seconds before Step 1 starts (>= 1).

isrTrackingTopic.description: Kafka topic monitored for ISR shrinkage and recovery time (RTO).

lagTrackingGroupId.description: Consumer group ID monitored for consumer lag spikes and recovery.

isrPollIntervalMs.description: Polling interval in milliseconds for ISR state tracking (>= 100).

lagPollIntervalMs.description: Polling interval in milliseconds for consumer group lag tracking (>= 100).

maxAffectedBrokers.description: Maximum number of Kafka brokers this plan is allowed to disrupt simultaneously (-1 for no cap, though DisruptionSafetyGuard always refuses plans that take down all brokers).

autoRollback.description: Automatically roll back faults (e.g., NetworkPolicies or KafkaNodePool scale-downs) when recovery times out.

disruptionStep.description: A single fault injection and recovery observation step within a DisruptionPlan.

name.description: Unique step name shown in dry-run previews, progress events, and JUnit reports.

faultSpec.description: Fault injection specification for this step.

steadyStateSec.description: Steady-state duration in seconds before injecting this step's fault (>= 0).

observationWindowSec.description: Post-fault observation window in seconds to wait for ISR and lag recovery (>= 1).

requireRecovery.description: When true, the step fails (and triggers autoRollback if enabled) if ISR and lag do not recover within observationWindowSec.

faultSpec.description: Parameters defining a Kubernetes or Kafka chaos fault injection.

experimentName.description: Unique identifier or Litmus ChaosExperiment name for this fault (e.g., broker-hard-crash, pod-network-loss).

targetNamespace.description: Kubernetes namespace containing the target pods.

targetLabel.description: Kubernetes label selector (e.g., 'strimzi.io/component-type=kafka,strimzi.io/broker-role=true'). Must not be empty.

targetPod.description: Specific pod name to target instead of selecting by targetLabel.

targetAll.description: When true, injects the fault into all pods matching targetLabel rather than selecting one.

chaosDurationSec.description: Fault duration in seconds (0..3600). Must be >= 1 for NETWORK_PARTITION, NETWORK_LATENCY, CPU_STRESS, MEMORY_STRESS, IO_STRESS, DNS_ERROR, DISK_FILL, and NODE_DRAIN.

delayBeforeSec.description: Delay in seconds before fault injection begins (0..600).

envOverrides.description: Litmus ChaosEngine environment overrides. Only TARGET_NODE and NODE_LABEL are permitted.

TARGET_NODE.description: Explicit Kubernetes node name to drain during NODE_DRAIN.

NODE_LABEL.description: Kubernetes node label selector used by Litmus to pick a node to drain.

targetBrokerId.description: Specific Kafka broker ID to target (>= 0), or -1 for any matching broker.

networkLatencyMs.description: Injected egress network latency in milliseconds for NETWORK_LATENCY (1..30,000).

fillPercentage.description: Target disk fill percentage for DISK_FILL or IO_STRESS (1..100).

cpuCores.description: Number of CPU cores to saturate for CPU_STRESS (1..64).

memoryMb.description: Amount of memory in MiB to consume for MEMORY_STRESS (1..32,768).

ioWorkers.description: Number of concurrent I/O worker threads for IO_STRESS (1..64).

gracePeriodSec.description: Pod termination grace period in seconds for POD_DELETE / POD_KILL (0..300).

targetTopic.description: Kafka topic name for leader-aware targeting in disruption plans (1..249 ASCII chars).

targetPartition.description: Partition index (>= 0) whose leader broker is targeted when targetTopic is set.

probes.description: Fault-scoped probes. Note: cmdProbe is forbidden inside FaultSpec.probes; use kafkaProbe or k8sProbe.

probeSpec.description: Health probe evaluated during a disruption step.

type.description: Probe execution mechanism: kafkaProbe (Kates AdminClient check), k8sProbe (Kubernetes resource check), or cmdProbe (pod exec).

mode.description: Litmus probe evaluation mode: SOT, EOT, Continuous, Edge, or OnChaos.

command.description: For kafkaProbe: 'under-replicated-partitions', 'unavailable-partitions', 'produce <topic>', or 'consumer-lag [<group>]'. For k8sProbe: 'kafka Ready'. For cmdProbe: shell command.

expectedOutput.description: Expected output string or number compared against the actual probe output.

intervalSec.description: Polling interval in seconds between probe evaluations (>= 1).

timeoutSec.description: Maximum execution time in seconds for a single probe evaluation (>= 1).

type.description: FaultSpec.probes only permits kafkaProbe or k8sProbe (cmdProbe is refused inside FaultSpec).

slaDefinition.description: Service Level Agreement thresholds used by Kates SlaGrader to grade a disruption run.

maxP99LatencyMs.description: Maximum allowed p99 latency in milliseconds (> 0).

maxP999LatencyMs.description: Maximum allowed p99.9 latency in milliseconds (> 0).

maxAvgLatencyMs.description: Maximum allowed average latency in milliseconds (> 0).

maxErrorRate.description: Maximum allowed error rate as a fraction between 0.0 and 1.0.

maxRtoMs.description: Maximum allowed Recovery Time Objective (RTO) in milliseconds (> 0).

maxRpoMs.description: Maximum allowed Recovery Point Objective (RPO) in milliseconds (> 0).
